This synthetic declaration uses a constant author predicate: the outcome is stipulated by the definition. It demonstrates rule dispatch, not empirical identification.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(evaluably)
source(system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "evaluably"))
```

The complete synthetic declaration is installed at
`system.file("examples", "toy-workflow.R", package = "evaluably")`.
Its scientific choices are illustrative declarations, never engine defaults.

```{r}
t <- toy_spec("DEFINITION_IMPLIED")
r <- evidence_record(run_audit(check_audit(freeze_audit(t$spec), t$data), t$data), render = FALSE)
stopifnot(r$qualification$terminal_state == "DEFINITION_IMPLIED")
r$interpretation_license$disposition
```
